_description: US-056 / PC-C13 — coverage floor thresholds for core packages. defaultMaxDrop is the max-allowed percentage-point regression vs. coverage/baseline.json. To refresh the baseline after an intentional coverage shift, run `make test-cover-update`. SELF-404 calibrated broad pkg/oms and pkg/oss/objectset floors to current CI-backed race+coverage measurements; raise them in dedicated coverage-improvement stories. VTX-122 added the Vertex-stream floors (pkg/scenarios, pkg/vertex/graphsvc, pkg/timeseries @ 80%) plus excludeFiles: PG implementations live behind `//go:build integration` and are exercised by the testcontainers-backed integration job, so we drop them from the unit-test floor measurement.
